name: dlai-study-notes
description: DLAI Study Notes — multi-book corpus of personal study notes synthesized from deeplearning.ai courses. Consumer of @brandon_m_behring/book-scaffold-astro v4.25 (course-notes profile) with consumer-level multi-book extension.

scripts.predev: npm run build:bib --if-present && npm run build:labels --if-present && npm run build:figures
scripts.prebuild: npm run build:bib --if-present && npm run build:labels --if-present && npm run build:figures && npm run validate --if-present
scripts.validate: book-scaffold validate --preset course-notes && npm run lint:components && npm run lint:mcq
